heading.en: The vegetable cart and the corner shop

title.en: Explain the types of itinerant retailers
Explain the types of small fixed-shop retailers

say.en: The vegetable seller pushes his cart down your street every morning. The stationery shop near college never moves. Both are retailers. How are they different? In this lesson: Explain the types of itinerant retailers.
Explain the types of small fixed-shop retailers.

body.en: *Itinerant retailers* have no fixed place of business; they move from place to place to sell. They deal in consumer goods of daily use, operate with small capital, and focus on customer convenience. Types: peddlers and hawkers, who carry goods on a bicycle, cart or their heads from door to door; market traders, who open shops at different places on fixed days such as a weekly santhe; street traders or pavement vendors, who sell at busy street corners; and cheap jacks, who have independent shops of a temporary nature in a locality and keep changing their location.
body.kn: ಸಂಚಾರಿ ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸ್ಥಿರ ಅಂಗಡಿ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಇವರಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಕರ್‌ಗಳು, ಸಂತೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳು, ಬೀದಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಚೀಪ್ ಜ್ಯಾಕ್‌ಗಳು ಸೇರಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

body.en: *Fixed-shop retailers* sell from a permanent place. Small-scale types: general stores, which sell daily-use items in residential areas; speciality shops, which sell one type of product such as children's garments; street stall holders, who sell cheap goods from small stalls at street crossings; second-hand goods shops, which sell used items such as books and furniture; and single-line stores, which sell a single line of products such as readymade garments or watches in many sizes and brands.
body.kn: ಸಣ್ಣ ಸ್ಥಿರ ಅಂಗಡಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳು, ವಿಶೇಷ ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳು, ಬೀದಿ ಮಳಿಗೆಗಳು, ಹಳೆಯ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಏಕ-ಸಾಲಿನ ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳು ಸೇರಿವೆ.

problem.en: Classify: (a) a man who sells bangles door to door on a bicycle; (b) a trader who sets up at the Tuesday santhe in one village and the Friday santhe in another; (c) a shop that sells only sports shoes of all brands and sizes; (d) a shop selling used college textbooks.

steps.en: (b) Different markets on fixed days: market trader (itinerant).
(c) One line of products in great variety: single-line store (fixed shop).
(d) Used goods: second-hand goods shop (fixed shop).

answer.en: (a) Hawker, (b) Market trader, (c) Single-line store, (d) Second-hand goods shop.
